name: OxZygen
author: 3dthc
summary: A dark, cinematic instrument: choirs, winds, brass, strings, bells, keys, mallets, synths and textures from CC0 recordings, in two layered slots with filter, lo-fi, tempo-synced delay and motion, reverb and sub. 200 presets; a metal-chamber screen whose vents glow as you play, in five themes. Also a VST3 for Mac and Windows and an AU for Mac.
